scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete real-parameter proof with exact reciprocal-amplitude bounds; finite numerical checks are only illustrations. The model predates the primary 2024 study, including a 1990 numerical paper on an equivalent variable order.
scientific_limitations: Excludes only strictly positive least-period-two orbits in a sharp sufficient parameter region; no global convergence or exclusion of higher periods. Earliest online release of the selected primary 2024 study is 2024-07-12. Priority risk remains because older same-map works have inaccessible full text.
title: Sharp positive two-cycle obstruction in a coupled-logistic predator–prey map
